summary: Documented and applied the rule that downstream retries must restore accepted same-date intake and resume at the first failed stage instead of recollecting raw sources.
issues: Repeated full collection wastes time and violates immutable accepted input rule
risks: Resume workflow still requires remote artifact availability
lessons: Repair the first failing stage and preserve successful upstream artifacts
reusable_rules: Do not recollect accepted same-date source artifacts on downstream retry
notes: Next production retry will use workflow resume_run_id and verify collection step is skipped
